title: Open Liveries airlines
description: The airlines with schemes or tagged jets here, by ICAO code: the name to show and the country of their operating certificate (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). An airline that closed before ICAO's three-letter codes (1987) is keyed by its IATA code and founding year instead (Republic, 1979–86: RC1979).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows, as a relative path.

airlines.description: Each airline with schemes or tagged airframes here, by its ICAO code.

country.description: Where its operating certificate is from (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

ceased.description: When it stopped flying under its own name: a past airline (a ghost flight's).
